payload.author: botantony
payload.body:
This project does not meet the notability requirements for inclusion into Homebrew-core: https://docs.brew.sh/Package-Acceptance-Policy#notability

For now you can create and maintain your own tap:
- https://docs.brew.sh/How-to-Create-and-Maintain-a-Tap
- https://brew.sh/2020/11/18/homebrew-tap-with-bottles-uploaded-to-github-releases/

Once it becomes notable enough, we would love to see it in the Homebrew-core repository
